title: Ruleset: jukebox
description: rules/<id>/jukebox.yaml: the jukebox the story opens (packages/session: Jukebox; shop/script_menu.c: openJukebox, tickJukeboxMenu).

lines_section.description: The MAPHEAD section of the owner's lines.

lines.description: The owner's lines in that section: before the list, over it, after a pick and when leaving.

unlock_trigger.description: While unset, the list leaves out the locked songs.

chosen_variable.description: The story variable that holds the song that plays.

no_track.description: The number that says no song plays.
